{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tweed blazer with a structured shoulder line and long sleeves in a classic navy tone (#000080), fabric woven from wool and cotton.
Wool-blend skirt falling to just above the knee in a soft camel hue (#d2b48c), featuring a gentle A-line cut.
Silk blouse with a relaxed fit and a round neckline in a muted beige color (#f5f5dc).
Leather ankle boots with a low heel and a pointed toe in dark brown (#3e2723).
This ensemble works perfectly for a workday at the office because it strikes a professional yet approachable balance within the "neat" dress code. The structured blazer and wool skirt provide warmth suitable for autumn weather, while the silk blouse adds a touch of refined femininity without being overly formal. The neutral color palette of navy, camel, and beige complements her warm skin tones and creates a cohesive, polished look that feels appropriate for a daily business environment."}
